comment: Opcodes are 32-bit, numbered group<<16|index. The numbering is recovered from the decrypted client by tools/opcodegroups.py: server-to-client ranges from NetClient's protocol group registry (cross-checked against per-class GetOpcode() getters), client-to-server opcodes from GetOpcode() getters each matched by a Write() that emits the opcode. Per-message names are not shipped, so 'entries' stay name-only until each handler is identified. See docs/EVIDENCE.md E13.
